summary: Recommends grouping inventory by function (webservers, dbservers) so playbooks target by role, with function-specific group variables and roles; hosts can belong to multiple groups.
questions: How should I organize groups in my inventory?
Can a host be in more than one inventory group?
How do I give all web servers the same variables?

answer_card.title: Group inventory by function
answer_card.answer_md: Create groups named for what nodes do, such as `webservers` or `dbservers`. Playbooks can then target by function, group variables can hold function-specific settings, and roles can handle function-specific tasks. A host can be in multiple groups.
